newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices down on warm weather.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices down on warm weather.

text.p: Millfeed values were mostly lower Tuesday as milder weather decreased demand and run times remained high, several cash dealers said.
"Run times seem to be fairly good, mostly 5-1/2 days, but there's no real perkiness in the demand side," a northeast dealer said.
Temperatures were in the 60s F in the southern U.S. Plains Tuesday and forecasts called for milder weather for the next two days.
Dealers had hoped last week's cold snap would increase demand and deplete inventories, but most merchants reported clients' needs were filled.
